title: ADR 0015: Structured `search_context` result — lossless blocks + per-arm provenance for machine consumers
summary: Adds a structured JSON result mode to search_context exposing per-block scores and content identity; a 2026-08-24 amendment records ADR 0022 superseding the opt-in part so structuredContent is always returned and blocks carry blob_sha.
notes: Status: Accepted. Partially superseded by ADR 0022 per in-document 2026-08-24 amendment: the opt-in `format=structured` decision no longer holds; structuredContent is always present and `format` controls only the text fallback. Filename hash suffix omitted (no hashing tool available in this environment); path-derived disambiguator used instead.
